title: Three Machines Suffice for Local Hardening of Electromechanical Oscillations
summary: The single-degree-of-freedom swing equation with sinusoidal coupling is locally softening: its oscillation frequency decreases with oscillation level near a stable equilibrium. Nonlinear modal interaction, however, can reverse this trend in multimachine systems. This letter gives a necessary-and-sufficient condition for strict leading-order local hardening, measured with respect to canonical action, in two symmetric three-machine operating-point families with equal or opposite power injections at the equal-inertia machines.
